verdict.rationale: Codex supports use via an API key (codex-gh-4), but this 'requires additional setup' and is secondary to the ChatGPT-account flow; community evidence confirms the latest gpt-5.3-codex model isn't yet available via API (codex-comm-5). No dedicated public API reference docs were found (docs.md and llms.txt probes 404), suggesting API access is present but not the primary or fully documented interface.
